payload.summary: The account svc_backup on host victim-web-01 experienced a brute force attack from IP 10.77.0.20, with 12 failed login attempts followed by a successful login. The source IP is known to the account and has been used previously, but the pattern of failed attempts followed by a successful login is indicative of a brute force attack. No documented changes explain this activity.

attack_chain.description: The attacker used brute force techniques to guess the password of the svc_backup account on the host victim-web-01.

risk_factors: Brute force attack indicates potential compromise
Successful login after multiple failures suggests attacker success

proposed_actions.justification: The account svc_backup experienced a brute force attack, indicating potential compromise. Disabling the account will prevent further unauthorized access.
